name: One Life
summary: Right now, somewhere in the world, babies are being born. One of them is you. Tap Be born and the globe spins, then stops on a single dot. Your country follows real birth shares, and your family's means and your sex follow that country's numbers. Births and life expectancy for 124 countries come from the UN World Population Prospects 2024. Your birth card shows how rare your birth is (1 in how many) and your chance of dying before age 5.
